summary: Santacruz Silver Mining filed a 6-K attaching a September 18, 2026 news release announcing completion of its acquisition of a 500-tpd Bolivian milling facility comprising two 250-tpd selective flotation circuits for lead-zinc with high-grade silver. The company paid US$4.6 million toward a US$9.2 million purchase price, with total investment including commissioning expected near US$14 million. The facility sits roughly 5 km from the Reserva mine and will be dedicated to San Lucas ore, freeing capacity at three existing plants. Commissioning is targeted for Q4 2026 with commercial production by year-end; watch ramp-up execution and 2027 volume guidance.
